mapper.select: SELECT * FROM order_record WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM order_record WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT id, plan_id, created_at, expire_at FROM order_record WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND status = 'paid' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.amount, o.status, COALESCE(p.name, '') AS plan_name, '在线支付' AS pay_type, o.created_at FROM order_record o LEFT JOIN plan p ON o.plan_id = p.id WHERE o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT * FROM order_record WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM order_record ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.merchant_id AS merchantId, COALESCE(m.name, '') AS merchantName, o.plan_id AS planId, COALESCE(p.name, '') AS planName, o.amount, o.status, '在线支付' AS payType, o.created_at AS createTime, o.created_at AS createdAt FROM order_record o LEFT JOIN merchant m ON o.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN plan p ON o.plan_id = p.id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_record (order_no, merchant_id, plan_id, amount, status, expire_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{merchantId}, #{planId}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{expireAt}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE order_record SET order_no = #{orderNo}, merchant_id = #{merchantId}, plan_id = #{planId}, amount = #{amount}, status = #{status}, expire_at = #{expireAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_record WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_record WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM order_record WHERE status = 'paid'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM order_record WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND status = 'paid'
SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM order_record WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{startDateTime} AND #{endDateTime} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) as total FROM order_record WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{startDateTime} AND #{endDateTime} AND status = 'paid' GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date ASC
